correctness.rationale: The nine explicit scalar equations exhaust the two matrix-square conditions and the vanishing commutator. If d or D is nonzero they force the affine component. Standard outer-product maps give dimensions 7,7 and irreducibility; a free affine component has dimension 8. Pairwise intersection equations give dimensions 6,5,6. Exhaustive independent literal-matrix tests for F_2,F_3,F_4,F_5 agree with every stated point-count consequence. The theorem is about reduced varieties only.
